verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for a chat and community platform, but the evidence pack never documents a personal data export or download package. The REST API (discord-docs-35) is framed as letting your apps interact with Discord data, not as a user-facing way to export all of your own data in open formats. Community reports of lost contacts after a server ban hint at lock-in but do not show an export feature either way.
